title: MATLAB for Engineers
summary: The book presents several approaches in the key areas of practice for which the MATLAB software package was used. Topics covered include applications for: _x0001_-Motors _x0001_-Power systems _x0001_-Robots _x0001_-Vehicles The rapid development of technology impacts all areas. Authors of the book chapters, who are experts in their field, present interesting solutions of their work. The book will familiarize the readers with the solutions and enable the readers to enlarge them by their own research. It will be of great interest to control and electrical engineers and students in the fields of research the book covers.
